title: Ankhorage Cerbos Infrastructure
summary: Provides a runtime-neutral Cerbos authorization service adapter as portable workload and policy intent.
purpose: Represent Cerbos authorization infrastructure without embedding Kubernetes- or Compose-specific materialization.
responsibilities: Contribute the Cerbos service workload to provider-neutral infrastructure desired state.
Package Cerbos policy files for runtime materialization.
Return the common infrastructure service adapter boundary.
boundaries: Does not define portable infrastructure contracts.
Does not evaluate application authorization decisions.
Does not contain Kubernetes- or Docker Compose-specific deployment branches.
audience: Infrastructure composition selecting Cerbos as an authorization service.
Runtimes that materialize portable service workloads and policy files.
useCases: Add a Cerbos authorization service to portable infrastructure intent.
Deliver Cerbos policy files to the selected runtime.
Compose Cerbos independently of the concrete runtime provider.

architecture.role: A runtime-neutral service adapter contributing Cerbos workload and policy artifacts.
invariants: Runtime-specific materialization belongs to the selected runtime adapter.
Cerbos policy artifacts remain explicit portable inputs.
The adapter exposes only the provider-neutral service boundary.

limitations: Application-level authorization calls and policy authoring workflows remain outside this package.
